Chapter 9: Community and Connection—Finding Support on the Journey
You know, no one really walks the path of “Must” all by themselves. Even when you’re chasing a dream that feels deeply personal, there are going to be moments filled with doubts, challenges, and, yeah, a little bit of loneliness. But having a community—a circle of people who get it, who cheer you on, and who understand what you’re trying to do—can make all the difference in the world.
There’s this story about someone who felt totally alone while chasing their creative dream. Maybe you’ve been there too—friends and family just don’t quite understand, and the fear of being judged feels overwhelming. But then, everything shifted when they found a group of people who were on similar journeys. Folks who were choosing “Must” in their own ways. Suddenly, that sense of belonging, those shared ups and downs, made the road ahead feel a lot less intimidating.
Most of us actually underestimate just how powerful connection can be. When you share your dreams, your fears, and even those tough setbacks with others, you create a space for accountability and encouragement. Isn’t it so much easier to keep moving forward when someone else believes in you? When you have a place to celebrate those little wins, or work through disappointment together?
And here’s something important—community doesn’t need to be big or official. Sometimes, it’s just one friend, a mentor, or a handful of fellow travelers. What really matters is feeling seen, heard, and supported. Those relationships? They give you perspective, fresh inspiration, and a gentle reminder that you’re not in this alone.
One person actually found that by teaching others, sharing their own process, and offering encouragement, they ended up motivating themselves even more. Helping someone else choose “Must” reinforced their own commitment, and it created this amazing cycle of support and growth.
The world of “Should” can feel isolating, but “Must” is all about connection. The more you share your story, the more you inspire others to do the same. And over time, a vibrant community of authenticity and courage begins to grow.
So, as you continue your journey, remember: you don’t have to go it alone. Find your people, share your story, and let the power of community carry you forward.
